meta.name: La primavera temprana
meta.description: El recién graduado Shang Zhitao se une como novato a una importante agencia de publicidad mundial. Su directo jefe, Luan Nian, le dice que deje de fumar desde el primer día, pero ella persevera a pesar de la presión y los desafíos para convertirse en una profesional capacitada.

videos.title: You Are Not Suitable
videos.overview: After botching a job interview at a reputed agency, Shang Zhitao scrambles to find her footing in Beijing while befriending her new roommate.

videos.title: The Workplace Isn’t Some Kind of Child’s Play
videos.overview: At a celebration dinner for landing a new project, Nian steps in to help Zhitao. Meanwhile, a mistaken identity threatens the peace at Sun Yu's place.

videos.title: Repaying Favor With Your Life
videos.overview: After Zhitao escapes an assailant during a rainy mountain shoot, she and Nian must rely on each other when a landslide leaves them stranded.

videos.title: Follow Me Home
videos.overview: A woman from Nian's past derails his dinner with Zhitao, while a chance encounter at a bar brings his growing jealousy to the surface.

videos.title: Can You Control the Feeling of Love?
videos.overview: After an unexpected night with Nian, Zhitao insists on keeping their relationship strictly professional despite his efforts to win her over.

videos.title: The First Cup of Osmanthus Milk
videos.overview: Determined to distance herself from Nian, Zhitao applies for a job transfer, but his refusal to let her go tests the boundaries they agreed upon.

videos.title: An Ambitious Person Will Never Be Defeated by Life
videos.overview: Zhitao tries to focus on work and avoid Nian, but a new project forces her to seek his help as jealousy begins to cloud their judgment.

videos.title: The First Person To Fall in Love Will Lose Everything
videos.overview: While Zhitao earns praise for her database, Nian is suspended over a malicious complaint, prompting the two to go on a mountain retreat together.

videos.title: Love Is Stolen Candy
videos.overview: With a limited budget, Zhitao secures sponsorship for the basketball tournament, impressing her colleagues as Nian makes a surprising proposal.

videos.title: Being With You Is Like a Leap of Faith
videos.overview: A secret romance blossoms between Zhitao and Nian, but a workplace blunder threatens the careful balance they've worked to maintain.

videos.title: Love Begins on a Bittersweet Note
videos.overview: When Zang Yao accepts the flowers sent to the office, she unwittingly causes Zhitao to get the wrong idea and take a break from work with her roommates.

videos.title: Snow Falls With You Beside Me
videos.overview: Tensions rise between Nian and Zhitao when he tries to take care of her over the holiday break. Meanwhile, Yao decides to make a move on her crush.

videos.title: Do We Have a Future?
videos.overview: Zhitao receives an unexpected job offer during a company retreat in Phuket, but a seaside conversation leaves her at odds with Nian.

videos.title: Love Is Making Exceptions
videos.overview: While her roommates Yu and Yuanzhu are occupied at the hospital, Zhitao faces harassment from a shady rental agency, prompting Nian to intervene.

videos.title: Two Persons, One Heart
videos.overview: While Zhitao wrestles with doubts about her future with Nian, a new general manager works to erode his authority at the office.

videos.title: Thinking of You This Second Seeing You the Next
videos.overview: Dony tries to lure Zhitao to his side as Nian grows increasingly wary of his new boss. Meanwhile, Zang Yao prepares to return to the UK.

videos.title: Courage Is Acting Despite Fear
videos.overview: After learning of Dony's inappropriate workplace behavior, Zhitao takes matters into her own hands, causing an uproar at work and worrying Nian.

videos.title: Bucket List
videos.overview: Nian's jealousy flares after a misunderstanding at a speed-dating event, and a chance encounter with Zhitao's ex deepens the divide between them.

videos.title: Another Leap of Faith
videos.overview: Nian grows wary when Zhitao considers pursuing work opportunities outside the city. A health scare finally forces the couple to confront their future.

videos.title: I Will Watch Over You From Beyond This World, Until Your Life Is Whole
videos.overview: Yuanzhu finally confesses his feelings to Zhitao, but when devastating news arrives, Nian mistakes her compassion for something more.

videos.title: A Grand Retreat
videos.overview: An office scandal dampens Zhitao's chances of winning a company award, pushing her to reconsider her career — and her future with Nian.

videos.title: The Number You Dialed Is Not in Service
videos.overview: Nian uncovers the truth behind Zhitao's sudden departure, while she returns to Harbin to care for her father and begin again.

videos.title: Luke Is My Dog Too
videos.overview: Nian tries to win Zhitao's forgiveness after finding her in Harbin, using visits with Luke to slowly work his way back into her life.

videos.title: Shang Zhitao, Welcome Back to Beijing
videos.overview: A financial crisis draws Nian back to Harbin, where helping Zhitao gives the former couple a chance to confront their fractured relationship.
